description: This file is a Perl script used for building firmware images for Broadcom devices. It processes kernel and root filesystem images, applies headers, and creates a combined binary image with specific format and metadata. The script includes functions for reading files, padding buffers, and creating the image with relevant headers and CRC checks.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding length needed to align data to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to reach a specific length aligned to block size.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Creates a firmware image with appropriate headers, CRCs, and embedded kernel and root filesystem images.
